audience: inventory and sales teams that track stock and orders in Qoblex

useCases.title: Find products that are low on stock
useCases.text: List the products, then list their variants and read the stock of one variant, including incoming stock.

useCases.title: Check open sale orders
useCases.text: List the sale orders filtered by status and creation date, then open one order to read its line items.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders for a supplier
useCases.text: List the suppliers, then list the purchase orders sent to them, with their creation dates.

useCases.title: Look up a customer record
useCases.text: List the customers with filters and sorting, then read the record of one customer.

useCases.title: Confirm the account and the API user
useCases.text: Read the user that owns the API key, and the account details, to confirm the connection.
